sourceFile: 12. BRS-161014  GMI Report test VP mold #8 old lot NG high already return_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The file has usable VP#8 old-lot NG evidence, but the draft grouping and outcomes are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor mixes mold, lot, line, and normal references without preserving C2/E2 and lot groups.
Key conclusion rows 50-54 are not cited in the review case evidence.
Baseline/test pairing appears arbitrary, mainly comparing Normal VP #12 to VP #8 rows.
Draft omits VP#8 lot 240809017 and under-represents lot-level can/cannot decisions.
Measurement outcomes are misparsed numeric stats from headers, lot IDs, and picture context.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as VP#8 old lots versus normal VP reference, with C2/E2 and lot as subgroup keys.
Cite rows 50-54 as conclusion evidence and include related data rows for each lot/line.
Separate process bending/laser NG and function NG as outcomes under the same validation report.
Remove bogus measurement-stat outcomes from headers, lot IDs, and picture rows.
Create subresults by lot and line: 240809017, 240814027, 240816006, 240821007.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are semantically insufficient until conclusion and subgroup rows are cited.
